overlays.label: MSVC80 runtime
overlays.description: Visual C++ 2005 (msvcr80/msvcp80) redistributable DLLs. Needed by many older VN engines that shipped with the VS2005 runtime.

overlays.label: WinHTTP
overlays.description: winhttp.dll. Needed by installers/launchers or games that make HTTP calls (update checks, license pings, etc.) through WinHTTP.

overlays.label: MFC 14 runtime
overlays.description: mfc140u/mfcm140u from the Visual C++ 2015-2022 x86 redistributable. Wine has never implemented MFC, so games built with it cannot start without these; the rest of that runtime (ucrtbase, vcruntime140, msvcp140) Wine already provides.
